subject: Privileged session retention & SAML/SCIM artifacts for PineWell
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@brightaudit.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@pinewell.health>
Date: 2028-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: privileged session retention & SAML/SCIM artifacts for PineWell

Hi Diego,

We're starting the access-control portion of PineWell's SOC 2 / SIG review and need a short bundle of artifacts to validate retention and traceability controls. In scope:
- Privileged session retention (admin/service accounts) — export of session logs or a snapshot covering the last 90 days.
- SAML assertion samples tied to admin console logins and at least one service-account assertion (redacted).
- SCIM provisioning delta for the last 30 days showing create/update/deactivate events.
- RBAC mapping or owner roster showing role owners for "admin" role families.

Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA? Ideally we want redacted artifacts (no PHI) by end of next week. If there are any constraints (redaction, encryption, or if you prefer to share a secure Drive link), please let us know.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Kim
Senior Auditor — BrightAudit

(attachment: access-control-questionnaire-v2.pdf)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@brightaudit.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@pinewell.health>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-02T11:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: privileged session retention & SAML/SCIM artifacts for PineWell

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear scope. Looping in Irene (security) and Sean (ops) to assemble the bundle. High-level plan:

- We will provide a redacted bundle with SAML assertion samples (admin + service account), a SCIM delta CSV for 30 days, and a snapshot export of privileged-session records for the last 30 days. Full 90-day raw logs are available but we prefer to redaction + deliver a redaction map.
- Delivery method: secure Google Drive folder with ACLs + a separate redaction_map.txt describing fields removed.
- Target ETA: initial bundle by 2028-11-05 EOD PST. If you need raw logs for sampling rather than redacted, tell us and we'll open a secure SFTP window.

Irene / Sean — can you confirm the filenames and whether we should include a short statement about retention policy (days retained / archival process)?

Thanks,
Diego
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

> On 2028-11-01 09:12, Sara Kim wrote:
> > We're starting the access-control portion...
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Sara Kim <sara.kim@brightaudit.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@pinewell.health>
Date: 2028-11-03T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: privileged session retention & SAML/SCIM artifacts for PineWell

Hi Sara / team,

Per Diego — attaching the redacted bundle and a short narrative. Attached:
- sso_assertion_samples_redacted.zip (5 examples: 3 admin console assertions, 1 service-account assertion, 1 federated-id assertion). All PII removed; assertion IDs replaced with SHA256 hashes.
- scim_delta_sample.csv (CSV of SCIM events, columns: timestamp,event_type,user_id,external_id,actor).
- privileged_session_snapshot_2028-10-31.json (exported session records for the last 30 days; fields redacted where necessary).
- redaction_map.txt (explains the redaction rules and mapping between original fields and redacted placeholders).

Quick notes:
- Retention: admin-level audit logs (console authn & privilege elevation events) are retained 365 days in the audit log store. Privileged session recordings/attachments are retained 180 days by default.
- Keys & encryption: session tokens and assertion artifacts are encrypted at rest using AWS KMS (us-west-2). Decryption keys are rotated every 12 months; HSM-backed key material is used for signing SAML assertions.
- RBAC owners: we will provide the owner roster link in HubSpot (shared) rather than as an attachment — it contains PII and owner contact details. Link included below.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/fake/redacted-artifacts
HubSpot RBAC record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/HS-56789

If you need a longer retention export (90 days) or raw assertion logs with source IPs, we can stage that via SFTP under an NDA process — let me know which you prefer.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Security Ops — Redwood Inference
(attachment: sso_assertion_samples_redacted.zip, scim_delta_sample.csv, privileged_session_snapshot_2028-10-31.json, redaction_map.txt)

> On 2028-11-02 11:07, Diego Fernandez wrote:
> > Looping in Irene (security) and Sean (ops) to assemble the bundle...
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@brightaudit.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@pinewell.health>
Date: 2028-11-05T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: privileged session retention & SAML/SCIM artifacts for PineWell

Diego / Irene — received the bundle and the drive link. Quick clarification requests before we close this item:
1) In the assertion samples the actor/source_ip field was redacted. For the SOC 2 traceability check we need confirmation that ephemeral/admin sessions include actor_id and source_ip in original logs; can you confirm they are captured and retained (we don't need raw IPs in the bundle, just confirmation and one example assertion ID that contains source_ip in the original)?
2) You documented retention windows (365 / 180) — can you confirm these apply to both US and EU tenants, or is EU tenant archival handled differently?

If you can reply with those two clarifications (a one-line confirmation for each) we'll mark this as received and move to sample verification. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Best,
Sara
BrightAudit
